links.outcome: Functional stratification accuracy in internal versus real-world cohorts
links.effect: Functional stratification accuracy was 0.91 in the internal cohort and 0.89 in the real-world cohort; AUC for levator dysfunction was 0.993.
links.quote: The functional module identified levator dysfunction with an area under the curve of 0.993, achieving robust functional stratification accuracy in both internal (0.91) and real-world (0.89) cohorts.

screen.reason: Evaluates a smartphone video-based diagnostic and dialogue system for pediatric blepharoptosis in a prospective multicenter clinical trial/real-world deployment, measuring diagnostic accuracy, expert evaluation, and patient satisfaction without testing specific deployment safeguards.
